title: Nurse speaks for first time in Virginia

tellings.quote: there was also, I think, a nurse there who had worked under you. And for the first time, she started to speak about this being.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels interviewed a surgeon whose hospital, the episode says, operated on an alien being. Michels says that a nurse who had once worked under this surgeon has, for the first time, begun to speak about the being. If true, it would add another voice from inside the hospital to the claim that a non-human creature was treated there.
